consumer_build.bmi_scope: consumer compiler module-map import closure, plus all already-built BMI artifacts including private partitions; not parsing latency

environment.cache_policy: normal OS caches; no cache dropping

consumer_build.rss_scope: OS time command high-water RSS normalized to KiB; not summed concurrent compiler RSS
consumer_build.scope: one fresh core-import consumer and three source-only recompiles per revision; library BMIs prebuilt by benchmark build

environment.cache_policy: normal OS caches; no cache dropping

budgets.charged_scope: subprocess wall time, conservative including setup and validation; builds and fixture copies excluded

counter_scopes.backend: TransferContext logical transfer stats where available; null means unavailable
counter_scopes.codec_cpu: diagnostic only; sum intercepted ZSTD create/free call thread CPU and compress2/decompressStream thread CPU; operation uses process CPU; clock/interposition overhead and unobserved internal calls limit attribution
counter_scopes.libc: interposed read/pread/readv/write/pwrite/writev; not direct syscalls; includes codec file traffic
counter_scopes.new: C++ global throwing new/new[], including aligned; requested bytes, not live bytes; C malloc/system allocations excluded
counter_scopes.rss: whole process high-water RSS, includes initialization and correctness validation
counter_scopes.sampling: counts, RSS, backend/libc/codec metrics from one separate instrumented diagnostic execution per scenario/revision; excluded from five timing samples

native_suite.order: baseline,candidate repeated five times per scenario
native_suite.timing_observers: no preload/injected observers; ordinary global C++ allocation functions

csc_opposite_gather_copy.interpretation: One repeat retained a separated effect at the 5% threshold. The other repeat overlapped and the earlier pre-split run showed no resolved change. Identical allocation counts and similar separate diagnostic CPU times do not establish an implementation cause.
csc_opposite_gather_copy.source_scope: The copy and planning routines are source-identical. The dtype range now includes binary16, and the sparse allocation boundary has the new rejection guard.
csc_opposite_gather_copy.work: Eight checked opposite-axis gathers from a 512 by 512 CSC matrix using the fixed nonmonotone 256-position test geometry

binary_inspection.select_instruction_difference_scope: only relative displacements of three calls to the same cold fail helper

gather_select.interpretation: The timing difference repeats on two physical cores with alternating sample order. The changed linked layout is a possible contributor. The measurement does not identify a microarchitectural cause.

isolation_control.change: Moved only the new binary16 conversion definitions to a separate core implementation translation unit

gather_select.timed_work: 10,000 checked acquisitions, each validating 256 gathered positions in a 512 by 512 dense FP32 view

module_sample_replacement.exclusion_reason: The first baseline command also rebuilt its arrays implementation and core archive. That interval measured different work.
module_sample_replacement.matched_scope: Both first commands contain exactly one consumer translation-unit compilation and one link against prebuilt library BMIs.
